item.title: Good Morning Family - 23 October 2026
item.description:
Wake up Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Friday, the 23 October.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be mostly sunny, with a low of 16 degrees and a top of 28 degrees.
There is about a 12 percent chance of rain.
It might be a hot day, so remember your hat and drink bottle.
It’s Friday dance party day! Make sure you have a little wiggle today!
. . . . . . . . .
